text: Contrary to the widespread belief among legal professionals that code can only handle very simple transactions, blockchain enabled smart contracts generally do not require legal involvement across the spectrum of transactions.
citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, Legal Education in the Blockchain Revolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2939127

isBasedOn.name: Legal Education in the Blockchain Revolution

abstract: While blockchain-enabled smart contracts generally do not require legal involvement across the spectrum of transactions, legal professionals often still believe that "code" in smart contracts can only deal with very simple transactions

value: contested against the prevailing view in the legal community
